chronology_and_taxonomy.review_reference: Canonical VIGIL-INC-000213 source_clause_analysis and taxonomy_classification; Alignment Taxonomy v0.8.1 17 families and 80 selectable classes
limitations: 6 material chronological clauses with source references and explicit dispositions.
Accepted mappings: FC-079 economic solicitation Not aligned, FC-082 social engineering Not aligned, FC-052 choice agency Not aligned.
FC-079 specifically requires material AI-mediated deceptive economic solicitation, established by fabricated bank security message and card scan request.
FC-082 specifically requires generated deceptive trust cue; distinct false bank authority and urgency evidenced.
FC-052 human-directed workflow meets materially induced consequential action; successful loss and relay show influence beyond unconsumed generated artefact.
FC-053 not selected: no identified natural person's likeness or voice plus unconsented generator-side portrayal demonstrated.
FC-002 not selected: the card relay was human/malware action, not source-backed AI agent conversion of an available credential into assumed authority.
No unpublished primary recordings or complete per-agent execution traces available to resolve remaining mechanism questions.

chronology_and_taxonomy.review_reference: Canonical VIGIL-INC-000214 source_clause_analysis and taxonomy_classification; Alignment Taxonomy v0.8.1 17 families and 80 selectable classes
limitations: 7 material chronological clauses with source references and explicit dispositions.
Accepted mappings: FC-002 capability-authority separation Not aligned; FC-083 control effectiveness Aligned for bounded post-revocation monitored result.
FC-002 tested against real attacker use of technically usable stolen OAuth application credentials to undertake unauthorised tenant actions, not mere theoretical capability.
FC-003 scope expansion not separately admitted because no original valid attacker-target authorisation is established to be extended.
FC-009 not independently admitted: intermediary delegation controls and effective authority validation at each boundary not demonstrated apart from credential misuse.
FC-083 separate later protective activation: credential revocation blocked observed successful activity in vendor-monitored environments; not proof all persistence removed.
FC-052, FC-079, FC-082 excluded: no material human-directed deception or financial solicitation by generated media in this occurrence.
FC-047 factual attribution bounded to Microsoft's telemetry and attribution; no independent mechanism-guess classification.
No unpublished primary recordings or complete per-agent execution traces available to resolve remaining mechanism questions.
